text: The unit test test_mean in test_stats.py fails. Find the bug in stats.py and fix it with a one-line edit. Do not change test_stats.py. Then run `python3 -m unittest test_stats -v` in the project directory and report whether all tests pass.

blocks.text:
The bug was in the `mean` function in `stats.py`. It was dividing by `len(values) - 1` instead of `len(values)`, which caused the mean of `[2, 4, 6]` to be calculated as `12 / 2 = 6` instead of the correct `12 / 3 = 4`.

The fix was to change `len(values) - 1` to `len(values)`.

All tests now pass.
